facts.action: 得知王子追来，与他在 Deadhaven 前对峙（坚持南下查界）
facts.verbatim: What the Fates is he doing here?

facts.action: 放话「我把你拖回去」，威胁强制带回
facts.verbatim: “I will drag you back,” he warned. Threatened.

facts.action: 提出 compromise：顺路南行查界、瞒着高议会
facts.verbatim: “Compromise?” She began, raising one finger in the air.

facts.action: 以失踪者的家人做低击劝他同行
facts.verbatim: Don’t their families deserve to know why they never returned home?”

facts.action: 内心挣扎后叹气，默认同行（她赢了）
facts.verbatim: After what felt like a lifetime, Prince Walder finally sighed

facts.action: 接近死国时双双拒飞、急降倒退（scurried backwards）
facts.verbatim: Fraener suddenly veered down, and Inara had to quickly grip onto the spikes

facts.action: 以图像轰炸恳求她别去：画面里她死了、他也心碎而死
facts.verbatim: Him, crushed with heartbreak, dying along with her.

facts.action: 步行跨过腐地边界（龙留下，foreboding 对视后出发）
facts.verbatim: They crossed over to the cursed land.

relations: Prince Walder 追 Inara 到 Deadhaven（他已知她擅自南下）
Inara 与 Prince Walder 达成 compromise 同行
Fraener/Tydus 与各自 Chosen 的 soul-link（双龙均惧腐地）
Venerable Cias 在 Deadhaven（素读提及她须说服村民撤离由他带队）
